learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected B takes over, starting eight times as common with break-even five versus A two, and locked it in.
observations.exploration: Day20 gave A26, B35, nutrient3.9. Day400 gave A80, B0, nutrient2. Changing B need to3 still A80/B0/nutrient2. Changing B need to1 reversed to A0/B90/nutrient1 and unlocked reveal.
observations.reveal: Corrected original A winner, cites both day400 outcomes. Explains winner draws nutrient to own break-even, below rival's threshold causes decline regardless starting abundance. One limiting nutrient condition, several nutrients may allow coexistence.
observations.visual: Inline initial/final reversed screenshots inspected: species dots switch from mostly red initial to all red at B-needs1, nutrient bar ends at B1 below A2 markers. Readout text and buttons legible. Trust5/5 ignored.
observations.isolation: No-history evaluation preview banner present. Visible trust count ignored.
observations.reference: Own CUA tab 543884122 snapshots and inspected inline screenshot; no screenshot file saved.
